poc_summary: Hosted trial findings: 4-week trial across staging and a small portion of prod traffic (beta customers). UX: positive for chat/FAQ flows. Quality: stable using 7B / 13B open model variants. Observed average latency (hosted streaming): 210ms first-byte for short chats; 1.8s for 2k-token summaries. Cost: hosted estimate extrapolated ~$12k/month for current beta traffic (120M tokens/mo). Team requests dedicated pricing to get to sub-$5k/month token cost for production. POC ask: deterministic latency SLO (p50 <250ms), 99.9% uptime, and private VPC connectivity.
capacity_forecast: Traffic profile from trial (week-average): avg QPS 4.2, weekday peak QPS 22, steady concurrency 6-10, burst concurrency up to 28 during morning syncs. Token mix: 72% short-chat (<256 tokens, avg 120 tokens), 18% medium (256-1024, avg 480 tokens), 10% long summaries (>1024, avg 2,100 tokens). Avg tokens per request: ~180. Current monthly token volume (trial extrapolated): ~120M tokens. Forecast for 12 months (with 3x product growth and broader rollout): 360M tokens/mo, average QPS ~12, peak QPS ~65, sustained concurrency estimate 18-30. Request for autoscaling to handle concurrency spikes while keeping p99 latency below 1.2s.
recommended_dedicated_config: Redwood SE recommendation (initial): Dedicated pool sized for predicted 3x growth headroom. Suggested starting pool: 3x A100-equivalent inference nodes (GPU type to be finalized in POC), with autoscale up to 6 nodes for peak windows. Rationale: with MapleCroft token mix (mostly short chats), a single A100-equivalent node expected throughput ~25-30 QPS for target model (7B quantized) with p50 latency ~180ms. That yields baseline capacity ~75-90 QPS with 3 nodes, autoscale to ~180 QPS at 6 nodes for peaks. Cache + continuous batching recommended (KV prefix caching for repeated doc lookups reduces token load by ~12-18%). Networking: VPC peering + private endpoints; KMS integration for keys. Ops: enable per-route tracing and token-level billing to enforce budgets. Rollout plan: 2-week dedicated sizing POC using customer testnet -> validate real QPS and p99s -> adjust node count/instance type.
